Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
So you crave a Potion of Time Travel, do you? Yes, yes, I have just the thing… shard of frozen lightning… a few sprigs of primrose… chipped gargoyle claw… and I almost forgot! All the incredible Doctor Who cards from Spookydrop 2023! All the foils, all the non-foils, all the Doctor Who. These cards are brimming with the mysteries of space-time, and the beauty of space-time for that matter. Brilliant!

Contents:
• 1x Secret Lair x Doctor Who: The Weeping Angels Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Doctor Who: The Dalek Lands Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Doctor Who: The Weeping Angels Non-Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Doctor Who: The Dalek Lands Non-Foil Edition
